bluf: Gravity Global is a 500 person B2B demand generation agency billing itself the world's most awarded, selling brand to demand work to enterprise buyers in aviation, healthcare, public sector and industrials. The record shows it rebuilding: a rebrand from 9thWonder, the Marketing Doctor media acquisition in 2025-08, a new CEO in 2025-10 and AI sold as its operating system through Synthetic Brand and Audience GPTs. The one thing a rival should know: 16 of 17 named clients are names only and no public pricing shows; it is likely, with moderate confidence, winning on awards and ABM tooling rather than evidenced outcomes.
doing:
The positioning line, in the record's words: a self styled world's most awarded marketing agency helping defiant B2B and B2C brands turn attention into growth, from brand to demand. In plain words: creative reputation first, pipeline second. The headline claim cites 935k qualified visits and leads and 15.3bn in orders, alongside 14 offices, 500 staff, 40+ years and a 93% client advocacy score on the about page, none audited in the record.

No line leads. Seven core lines sit at score 2: AI Automation / Agents (Synthetic Brand GPT, Synthetic Audience GPT, QA tools, personalization), B2B & ABM (ABM strategy and tech audits, 6sense Tier One and Trendemon partnerships), Content & Digital PR (always on PR, creative cases for Embraer, Airbus and Uponor), Creator & Influencer (creator partnerships, HondaJet and Embraer social content), Programmatic & CTV (programmatic display, broadcast, OOH and MMM, plus Marketing Doctor), SEO (technical, on page and content writing pages, a STACK case) and Web & Product (Sitecore and CMS pages, Honda Powersports and Craig Hospital website cases). Proprietary: the two GPTs, F.A.B. and Brand Strategy Intensives. Paid Search, Paid Social and AI Search / GEO score only 1.

The AI posture positions AI as its operating system, with AI search optimization and web personalization beside the GPTs; the Horus read scores P1 and P6 partial. Pricing: LinkedIn ads offer 6 to 8 week programmes to prove an approach, no prices shown, P5 unknown.

Moves in date order: 2020-12, joint venture with PR firm Lambert to pursue M&A; undated, a rebrand from 9thWonder, whose name older press slugs carry; 2025-08, acquired media agency Marketing Doctor; 2025-10, partnered with Trendemon and named Jose Lozano CEO; 2025-12, named Kyle Allen Managing Partner and Andy Blotner SVP, Head of Media. No news or jobs are listed. Conspicuously absent for an agency that bought a media shop: a paid line above score 1 and any Google ads of its own.
clients:
The client type is enterprise across aviation and aerospace, healthcare and life sciences, public sector and economic development, financial services, manufacturing and industrial, automotive and powersports, and technology. No HQ is given; offices are listed in the UK (London, Ashford, Norwich, Oxford), the US (Houston, Dallas, Denver, Los Angeles, Minneapolis), Hong Kong, Shanghai and Nha Trang.

The needs read holds 17 names, 1 observed and 16 names only, so the mix is brand and creative alone. The one observed need is the American Heart Association, from a press release on its ShowUsYourGood campaign to encourage acts of kindness. Two press slugs stay uncoded: Tourism Fiji's names the Find Your Bula campaign a finalist in the 2022 campaign US media awards, an award rather than described work, and Phillips 66's names 9thWonder agency of record for business to business marketing.

The other 14 are case pages with no captured title: Embraer, Airbus, Honda Powersports, HondaJet, Ecolab, MEDC (Michigan), MidFirst Bank, Payoneer, Craig Hospital, STACK, Uponor, Allegheny County, Toledo Region and VHIB. The capability notes add what the needs read does not code: creative campaign cases for Embraer, Airbus and Uponor, social content for HondaJet and Embraer, and website cases for Honda Powersports, Craig Hospital and STACK. For the rest the need is inferred from the sold mix, brand to demand with no lead line.

No client sits on another tracked agency's book (shared 0).

With KJ8 (human provenance becomes a distribution signal) its strongest tailwind at net 0.203 on creator and content lines, it is likely, with moderate confidence, that the aviation and industrial names keep buying creative and PR, and a roughly even chance that the public sector and healthcare names ask next for the audited AI visibility product the P1 partial read says it has not shown.
house: Say and do: 3 of 3 tested lines hold. LinkedIn advertising is corroborated: 24 company ads and 0 thought leader ads, a floor since 89 ads match the name query, plus 1 dynamic job ad; one sample offers targeted 6 to 8 week programmes to prove an approach before a full commitment, another reads 'At Gravity Health, complex science doesn't have to mean complicated marketing'. Publishing cadence is corroborated on 239 sitemap URLs updated in 365 days, though only 3 in 90 days out of 365 URLs, so the machine has slowed. Creator & Influencer is corroborated by its own instagram channel. The Radar flags no gaps. It runs no Google ads (status none, 0 in the record). No llms.txt, 1 AI topic URL and no AI crawlers blocked. The stack is gtm, hubspot, sixsense and cookieyes on HubSpot CMS, with sixsense the ABM stack; no social pixels and no test tools detected.
market:
The Horus read: tailwind index 11.9, band Favored, 51st percentile, integrity 100. Best placed for KJ8 (Human provenance becomes a distribution signal, net 0.203), driven by Creator & Influencer at +2 and Content & Digital PR at +1, and for KJ1 (The click is being replaced by the citation, net 0.131) on AI Search / GEO at +2. Most exposed to KJ5 (The price of attention splits in two, net -0.101) through Programmatic & CTV and Paid Social. Best fit: The Commons Rebuilt at 45/100. P moves: partial on P1, P6 and P7; absent on P2 and P8; unknown on P5; P3 and P4 not applicable.

The Monsoon read: index 50.8, band Breeze, 31st percentile, migration 59.3 against displacement 42.3. The verdict puts 47 of the index on the sold mix, SEO (9) and Web & Product (9) carrying the most movable hours, and sends 56% of the work to South and Southeast Asia and 35% to Eastern Europe. The class is observed: a delivery footprint in Nha Trang, Vietnam is listed, with no onshore claim.
openings:
The strongest opening is the book. 16 of 17 names are names only, so the world's most awarded claim rests on awards, not described outcomes: it is likely, with moderate confidence, that a rival who brings an aviation or industrial prospect a case with a pipeline number wins against a portfolio of logos. The falsifier: case pages for Embraer, Airbus or Honda Powersports appearing with described work and results at the next compile.

Second, the machine layer. It sells SEO and web builds as core lines and shows no feed, schema or entity work (P2 absent); a rival can very likely, with moderate confidence, claim the answer engine layer for its enterprise sites unopposed.

Third, price and delivery. No public pricing model shows (P5 unknown), and the Monsoon read observes a delivery footprint in Nha Trang, Vietnam: an onshore delivery pitch has something concrete to point at, and a transparent outcome priced offer has a roughly even chance of forcing a conversation it cannot have in public. The paid lines are contestable outright: Programmatic & CTV and Paid Social drive its KJ5 exposure, no Google ads of its own run, and P8 is absent.
watch: I6, platform AI labeling enforcement after the EU Article 50(2) deadline, 2 December 2026: new reach penalties for unlabeled AI personas or engagement would sharpen the KJ8 tailwind on its creator and content lines.

I2, Alphabet Q3 2026 search growth and AI Mode ad disclosures, late October 2026: growth below 10% flags cannibalization, while growth above 15% with AI Mode ads live confirms S1 and its KJ1 tailwind.
I10, Reddit US daily users against search referral volatility, late October 2026: US DAUq growth at or below 5% alongside AI Mode growth confirms the UGC starvation risk under KJ1.
I7, holiday 2026 agentic checkout volume and merchant opt out rates, December 2026 to January 2027: disclosed AI checkout GMV or high Shopify opt out rates would move the KJ4 read the edition tracks.

The 2025-08 Marketing Doctor acquisition and the 2025-12 media leadership appointments are the dated moves to follow: whether media becomes a core line above score 1 and whether Google ads of its own appear.
The next Radar compile refreshes offices, ads, sitemap cadence and clients, and this dossier is only as fresh as the 2026-09-28 compile.
